subject: prd/parallel-memory
statement: This ledger remains a supporting draft describing the two approved technical designs. The operator approved those designs, directed direct implementation without the formal planning process, and authorized publication as a three-PR stack. The operator then authorized fixing the conflicting staging gates before publication. Delivery proceeds under those instructions with the approved scope and no frozen plan; it does not claim a separate formal PRD sign-off. Any future frozen planning must obtain its own contract approval.
